Markets.summary: Jagatjit Industries reported its second-quarter net loss narrowed to Rs 3.96 crore from Rs 27.91 crore the previous year. Total income for the quarter surged 90 percent to reach Rs 195.43 crore.

Markets.title: Indian rupee snaps rising streak on hawkish Fed, oil rise
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee broke its rising streak due to escalating oil prices, a widening trade deficit, and a hawkish Federal Reserve. Although foreign investments provided some relief, they were not enough to spark a rebound.

Markets.title: Cisco shares rally after earnings beat: 6 key things investors need to know
Markets.summary: Cisco shares surged following strong first-quarter fiscal 2027 results that beat analyst estimates. Robust artificial intelligence data-center demand drove the revenue growth, prompting the company to raise its annual revenue and earnings forecasts.

Markets.title: Tesla-SpaceX Merger: Musk eyes December deal announcement
Markets.summary: Tesla and SpaceX are reportedly in advanced merger talks for a potential December announcement. The proposed deal exceeds $3.5 trillion and would combine their automotive, aerospace, AI, and robotics operations.

Markets.title: MSCI rejig: Which stocks may see the biggest inflows & outflows?
Markets.summary: MSCI is updating its indices on November 30, which will increase India's weight in the Emerging Markets Index. Coforge and LIC are expected to see significant financial inflows, while PI Industries may experience outflows.

Geo-Political.summary: African Miss Universe beauty queens are stranded in their home countries due to difficulties obtaining U.S. visas. Specifically, contestant Hall is currently stuck in South Africa while attempting to secure travel documentation.

Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit. This increase reached a two-year high, matching estimates from a Mint poll of 15 economists.

Data & Insights.summary: Moody's raised India's fiscal year 2027 economic growth forecast from 6.5% to 7% due to strong momentum and resilience against energy shocks. However, the agency warned that inflation, a deficient monsoon, and rising El Niño risks could threaten this growth.

Data & Insights.summary: PK Mishra stated that scientific research and detailed data are essential for solving climate and food security challenges. He emphasized that climate change impacts agricultural productivity, water availability, food prices, public health, and livelihoods.

India.title: India's Big Ambition: An Artificial Sun By 2042
